reviews.title: Great Resource
reviews.contents: Such an awesome free resource! Really well developed and easy to use app. I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Underrated app for parents!!!
reviews.contents: Amazing!!! I hope more parents discover this app instead of the apps of those fake influencers. This has so far been well researched and thought of. It is easy to navigate and very useful.

reviews.title: Amazing app for child development!
reviews.contents:
This app is truly amazing!

- It helps you understand all the milestones your baby goes through
- It has a tracker that is easy to use & visual
- It provides activity ideas to help your baby with easy to follow real life videos
- They provide great articles and resources for postpartum related topics 

Am so happy I found it.

reviews.title: New update has new bugs
reviews.contents:
The tummy timer was great but no longer works for manual entries or editing of past entries.

Will update once fixed.

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.contents: This app is very helpful for understanding of my baby development and milestones. It’s clear all my doubts. Videos are helping me out . Thanks for pathways team.
